newsitem.title: USA: Questar acquires Histotec of Iowa Inc.
newsitem.headline: Questar acquires Histotec of Iowa Inc.

text.p: Utah holding company Questar International Inc said Wednesday it had acquired all 200,000 outstanding shares of Histotec of Iowa Inc in a stock-for-stock exchange.
Questar said it had exchanged 10 of its shares for every one of Histotec on May 27.
Early Wednesday, Questar's stock was trading at 0.33 on the Nasdaq Small Cap against a close of 0.20 on May 27.
Questar said it will turn the closely-held company, which works in human DNA extraction and storage, into a wholly-owned subsidiary.
Questar said it had also signed a $2 million licensing agreement for exclusive rights to collect and isolate human DNA specimens within Iowa.
It signed a similar agreement for Missouri on March 7, it added.
Questar extracts DNA sequences from blood samples supplied by clients and stores them for future medical use.
